messages.author: e531efa2753b204e
messages.subject: Order of compiler flags
parts:
My installation of R on Mac OS comes with default compilation flags like this:

$ R CMD config CFLAGS
-mtune=core2 -g -O2

When I use devtools to load a package, it adds these flags:

> compiler_flags(TRUE)[["PKG_CFLAGS"]]
[1] "-UNDEBUG -Wall -pedantic -g -O0"

But PKG_CFLAGS are placed before CFLAGS, so that the compiler is called like this:

llvm-gcc-4.2 -arch x86_64 -std=gnu99 -I/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/include       -I/usr/local/include   -UNDEBUG -Wall -pedantic -g -O0 -fPIC  -mtune=core2 -g -O2  -c charstep.c -o charstep.o

It seems the later -O2 is overriding the earlier -O0. So when I am using gdb, the library being debugged doesn't correspond 1:1 to the C code, which makes for some confusion.

I can work around this by changing  ~/.R/Makevars, but I'd like to have -O0 when loading via devtools, and normal optimization when doing a vanilla install.packages(), without editing Makevars all the time. Is there a better workaround?

Peter
